Definition
Identifying a faulted component in an RL parallel circuit may require voltage or resistance measurements.
INTRODUCTIONM
AC current cannot be measured on most multimeters. Voltage measurements across a sampling resistor are used to measure current.
Dividing the voltage measurement by the sampling resistor's value will quickly determine if the branch current is correct. I = E
Resistance measurements isolate the fault to the resistor or the inductor.
